description: The one page, still one page

story.body: You read the sheet that was already there and did not write under it.

title: Looked at the one page

participation.context: Spoke, stopped, and did not answer himself.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You said the dead you talk to are in books, stopped before your mother's phrase was done, and left yourself the Friar's letter. You did not open the tomb.

title: Named Ovid, Marlowe, Kyd, and Greene, and stopped
